title: Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, Opentrons OT‑2 Run App version 3.19.0 or later, Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN1, Opentrons P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette, Opentrons P20 (or P10) Single‑Channel Pipette, 200 µL filter tips (recommended) or 300 µL tips, 10 µL/20 µL filter tips, NEST 96‑Deep Well Plate (2 mL capacity), 96‑well PCR plate, Zymo Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Kit (for Station B RNA extraction of the COVID Workstation), and any required reagents.

steps.title: Load samples into deep‑well plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 400 µL of each sample into the NEST 96‑Deep Well Plate (2 mL wells), arranging up to 48 samples in multiples of 8 as desired.

steps.title: Download the protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the Zymo Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral Kit protocol file from the Opentrons protocol library or the provided link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, use the ‘Upload protocol’ function to load the downloaded protocol file into the robot.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the magnetic module GEN1 on the deck, load the deep‑well plate with samples, load a 96‑well PCR plate for elution, and position the appropriate tip racks (200 µL filter tips or 300 µL tips, and 10/20 µL filter tips) according to the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate the positions of the tip racks, plates, and both the P300 multi‑channel and P20 (or P10) single‑channel pipettes, following on‑screen prompts or support articles.

steps.title: Execute the automated run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App; the robot will perform nucleic‑acid purification and dispense 60 µL of eluted DNA/RNA into each well of the 96‑well PCR plate, ready for downstream RT/qPCR, sequencing, or hybridization.
